notes:
Lead came from self-serve signup; initial product fit looks good for hosted_api. Primary pain: perceived latency for live chat — agents complain answers are 'snappy sometimes, laggy other times'. Customer metrics: session A (5 concurrent users) sees reply times 300ms->2s range; peak hours 8am-10am PST worst. They are running a single-region integration pointing at default endpoint. Quotes: "We see the app freeze while waiting for completions — users leave the chat."

Key facts captured in call: fragments + bullets ok. Customer added full ticket history into prompt to improve context retrieval — length now ~1500 tokens in some cases. They have high cost sensitivity; want to keep hosted API (no Dedicated) for now. No legal/regulatory residency needs, SOC2 and audit logging are nice-to-have. Current implementation uses 5s request timeout in frontend; backend retries on 502 with immediate retry. They used streaming in one test but not consistently.

Customer asked directly for quick wins: region selection advice, timeout/retry defaults, prompt-length best practices, and whether enabling streaming or smaller context windows would reduce perceived latency. SE recommendations given on call (see suggested_config). Customer is okay to run a short POC (1 week) if Redwood provides a simple config template and a perf checklist.

Stubs: pricing deck and perf notes in Drive, Fireflies id above, ticket INF-1017 created to track p95 spikes and log upload.
performance_requirements: Target p50 latency <300ms end-to-end for chat generation; p95 target <1s for 90% of sessions. Throughput modest: 30 reqs/min during peak. Cost sensitivity: keep incremental cost < $0.02 per session.
prompt_guidance: Current problematic pattern: embedding entire ticket thread in every request (~1k-1.5k tokens). Recommend: 1) summarize ticket history to <300 tokens before prompt (local short-summary step), 2) include only top-3 retrieved docs from KB, 3) use metadata fields instead of full text where possible, 4) cap assistant + user prompt to 600 tokens for baseline tests.
suggested_config: Primary routing: us-west-2 (closest infra to customers' users in PST) with eu-west-1 fallback for EU users
Timeouts: frontend request timeout -> 12s, server-side lambda -> 20s; avoid 5s frontend timeout which caused client aborts
Retries: implement exponential backoff with single retry on 5xx only; avoid immediate retry on 502 to prevent amplified latency
Streaming: enable response streaming for chat UI to display tokens ASAP — reduces perceived latency even if total generation time similar
Batching/caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts and cache KB retrievals for 60s
Prompt truncation: pre-flight token budget check and deterministic truncation policy (keep system + last user turn + summarized history)
Observability: add token-level timing with Redwood Console per-route dashboard; capture p50/p95 per region
POC plan: run 7-day A/B: current config vs tuned config (region + streaming + timeout changes); collect p50/p95 and user drop-off metric
